title: IoTTelemetryEvent
description: A single telemetry reading emitted by an IoT device onto the raw.iot-telemetry Kafka topic.

timestamp.description: Event time in ISO-8601 UTC, e.g. 2026-07-29T10:15:30.123Z. This is when the reading was TAKEN on the device, not when it was produced to Kafka -- the two can differ for offline/buffered devices, which is what makes late data realistic here.

value.description: Reading value. Valid range depends on metric_type; range checks are enforced downstream in Spark, not in this schema, since JSON Schema alone can't express conditional numeric ranges cleanly across four different units.

site_id.description: Optional logical grouping (e.g. cell tower / gateway site) a device is attached to.
